load_model_from_checkpoint: load a PyTorch Lightning or torch.nn.Module model from a checkpoint file with optional device, freeze, and eval settings
create_load_model_with_device: create a function to load a model from a checkpoint onto a specific device like cuda or cpu
test_load_model_freeze: test loading a model from checkpoint with freeze enabled to disable all parameter gradients
refactor_load_model_map_name: refactor the load_model_from_checkpoint function to support remapping state dict key names during load
review_load_model_state_dict_fn: review the load_model_from_checkpoint function and its custom state_dict_fn callback for applying arbitrary state dict transformations
